purpose: Test whether the BPSK regression in candidate A is caused by applying conjugate copies to BPSK, without changing class counts, seed, network, optimizer, preprocessing, thresholds, baseline arbitration or spectral rules.

candidates.C0: train = [raw, raw]; no augmentation; same total/per-class counts as C1
candidates.C1: train = [raw, copy]; copy is conjugate only for QAM16/QAM64; BPSK/QPSK copy is raw; same total/per-class counts as C0

selection_pipeline: final Round2 decision: candidate CNN + frozen baseline arbitration + frozen spectral gate + frozen max_softmax/margin/min_complex_rms

references.A_experimental_baseline: prior candidate A (all-class conjugate augmentation); read-only comparison, not the selection reference

eligibility.gate_quality: val known accepted accuracy >= frozen baseline val accepted accuracy - 0.01 AND gate_test rejection for OFF/NOISE/TONE/CLIP each >= frozen baseline gate_test rejection - 0.01
eligibility.bpsk_preservation: val BPSK recall >= frozen baseline val BPSK recall - 0.01
eligibility.qam16_improvement: val QAM16 recall >= frozen baseline val QAM16 recall + 0.02
eligibility.other_class_safety: val QPSK and QAM64 recalls each >= frozen baseline val recall - 0.02
eligibility.quality_gate_no_regression: all gate_test rejection rates must remain within 0.01 of frozen baseline (baseline is 1.0 on all four kinds)

selection.rule: Eligible candidates first; among eligible choose highest val macro-F1; tie-break by higher val QAM16 recall; if still tied, choose C1 (targeted augmentation) only if its BPSK recall is not lower; otherwise no candidate.

data_boundaries.sim_v1_test: known comparison set only; never used for checkpoint or candidate selection
data_boundaries.real_14_frames: development diagnosis only; not TRAIN, not independent acceptance; never used for candidate selection
data_boundaries.transforms: diagnostic only; not new real frames
